column1: # Rows db.ldo.* (line DBID loadord, 2026-11-16): one batch of a list of a version 5 database with the accession table and one without it, whose prefetch NCBI stops at the lookup of a parsed Seq-align id (`BLAST Database error: DB contains no accession info.`, exit status 2) and whose other subject's load opens a damaged taxonomy database (BLASTDB=bad_magic). NCBI loads the batch's Seq-align ids in the order of their Seq-id handles (m_Packed - 1 as an unsigned number, then the address of the handle's info) and writes the texts of the loads before the stop only: `.before.` multidb/ldb ldp (ldbn ldpn), `gnl|BL_ORD_ID|1` before `ref|NP_000002.1|`; `.after.` multidb/lda ldp (ldan ldpn), `gnl|BL_ORD_ID|0` (packed -1, after every number) never loads; `.unpacked.` multidb/pa put (na nut), every packed `gnl|BL_ORD_ID|n` before the `sp|` and `lcl|` ids, which are not packed (mixdb2 review 1 M2); `.tie.6` LOSAT's refusal of multidb/ldp ldu (ldpn ldun), `gnl|BL_ORD_ID|2` and the accession of the same packed number 2, whose order NCBI takes from the addresses of their handles (its texts change with the command line); `.held.6` LOSAT's refusal of multidb/lda ldg ldp (ldan ldgn ldpn), whose `gi|1|ref|NP_000002.1|` loads first and registers the accession in NCBI's data loader, so that NCBI never looks it up and does not stop (review 1 H1); `.query.6` LOSAT's refusal of multidb/lda ldq (ldan ldqn), whose `lcl|Query_1` NCBI's scope finds among the queries (H2). psiblast (`.ps.`): multidb/ldo_qc.faa, one query that hits both databases. As DECISIONS 60 (6) narrowed H1 and H2: `.copy.6` multidb/lda ldp ldc (ldan ldpn ldcn) with BATCH_SIZE=1, the second batch stops at ref|NP_000002.1| of ldp and its copy ldc (the same Seq-align id, the same lookup, which no batch before can have made); `.late.6` multidb/ldb ldh ldp (ldbn ldhn ldpn), whose `gi|9000|ref|NP_000002.1|` would load after the stop (handle 9000), so NCBI stops after the text of `gnl|BL_ORD_ID|1`; `.query2.6` multidb/lda ldq (ldan ldqn) with BATCH_SIZE=1, the second batch stops at `lcl|Query_1`, the first query, whose Bioseq NCBI's scope dropped after the first batch, and `.query2.5` LOSAT's refusal of the same in outfmt 5, whose report keeps the scope (NCBI goes on). psiblast's `.copy.6` and `.query2.6` use multidb/mix2_q.faa (a batch a query), its `.late.6` ldo_qc.faa (one batch). Review 2 of loadord (DECISIONS 60 (7), (8); fixtures make_multidb.py --loadord3-only): `.never.6` multidb/ldp ldx lda (ldpn ldxn ldan) with BATCH_SIZE=1, whose `gi|9001|ref|NP_000002.1|` holds the stopping accession but no batch reports it, so NCBI stops (M1); `.pd.6` multidb/lda ldq with -parse_deflines, whose scope holds the deflines' ids and no `lcl|Query_1`, so NCBI stops (M2); `.drop.6` LOSAT's refusal of multidb/lda ldq2 with multidb/ldo_short.* and -query_loc, whose first record the range drops but which keeps `Query_1` and stays in NCBI's scope, so that the second is `lcl|Query_2` (H2; NCBI goes on, blastx ends with its CSeqalign exception, exit 255); `.loaded.6` LOSAT's refusal of multidb/ldd lda ldp (BATCH_SIZE=1), whose `gi|9000|ref|NP_000002.1|` the first batch reports, so that NCBI's data loader holds the accession (NCBI goes on; not for blastn and blastx, which write the first batch's reports before the refusal); psiblast's `.q1late.it2.6` (multidb/lda ldq, -num_iterations 2: the second query's rounds stop at `lcl|Query_1`, which its scope does not hold, H1) and `.first.it2.6` (multidb/ldp ldx lda, ldo_qc.faa: the first round's prefetch stops, nothing loaded before it, H3); `.inq1.6` and `.inmy.6` LOSAT's refusals of -in_pssm with the PSSM's query `lcl|Query_1` (../fixtures/pssm/q1_tfp.asn.gz, multidb/lda ldq) and `lcl|myprot` (multidb/ldo_my.asn, lda ldmy), which NCBI's scope holds (H4), and `.inmyq1.6` NCBI's stop of the latter's PSSM with multidb/lda ldq (M2). Review 3 of loadord (DECISIONS 60 (10); fixtures make_multidb.py --loadord4-only), two stopping accessions in one batch, whose loads NCBI ends at the first lookup that it makes (H1): `.q1two.6` multidb/lda ldp ldq (ldan ldpn ldqn), `ref|NP_000002.1|` before `lcl|Query_1`, which the scope holds; `.cross.6` multidb/ldd lda ldp ldr with BATCH_SIZE=1, `ref|NP_000001.1|` of ldr before `ref|NP_000002.1|`, whose holder ldd the first batch loaded; `.rev.6` multidb/ldd lda ldp lds with BATCH_SIZE=1, NCBI skips `ref|NP_000002.1|` (ldd loaded) and stops at `ref|NP_000003.1|` of lds; `.inbatch.6` multidb/lda ldi ldp lds, `gi|1|ref|NP_000003.1|` of ldi loads first (its texts) and NCBI stops at `ref|NP_000002.1|` before lds's accession; psiblast's `.cross.6` and `.rev.6` use multidb/mix2_q.faa (a batch a query). With PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=1 and BATCH_SIZE=1 (H2): `.off.6` multidb/ldd lda ldp, outfmt `6 qseqid evalue`, the first batch's prefetch is off and its rows read no subject, so ldd is never loaded and NCBI stops at `ref|NP_000002.1|`; `.offread.6` LOSAT's refusal of the same with `6 qseqid sseqid evalue`, whose rows load ldd (NCBI goes on; not for blastn and blastx, which write the first batch's reports before the refusal). Review 4 of loadord (DECISIONS 60 (12); fixtures make_multidb.py --loadord5-only), version 4 copies of one record whose string ISAM index is a directory in l5d (l5dn), which NCBI's CSeqDBIsam::IndexExists (CFile::Exists, a regular file) takes for no ISAM, so that its lookups go on to the next volume (H1): `.v4dir.6` multidb/l5d l5e (l5dn l5en), the lookup of l5d's ref|NP_000002.1| finds l5e's copy; `.v4dirlate.6` multidb/l5c l5d (l5cn l5dn), the directory in the later volume.

# Rows db.ldo.

.e2*.5 (line DBID loadord, review 5 M1, 2026-11-17; fixtures make_multidb.py --loadord6-only): line RG K4h's E2 in loadord's shapes, BATCH_SIZE=1, outfmt 5, queries multidb/ldo_e2.faa (ldo_e2x.fna, ldo_e2.fna, ldo_e2t.faa; TBLASTX, which counts a Seq-align per subject, ldo_e2y.fna with multidb/ldyn added): q0 without hits, q1 titled `q1 ab z` (UTF-8), whose HSPs turn its batch's prefetch off under PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT (4; tblastx 56) and whose Iteration NCBI's XML stream cuts, so its report makes none of its loads, and q2, whose prefetch stops at ref|NP_000002.1| (`BLAST Database error: DB contains no accession info.`). The texts that q1's model left (the opening of a damaged taxonomy database, BLASTDB=bad_magic, or the offset error of offset_last_past_end) come at q2's first load before the stop that makes the same lookup, or not at all: `.e2sure.` multidb/ldb ldp, `.e2after.` lda ldp, `.e2skip.` ldb ldd ldp lds, `.e2lpx.` ldl ldp (nucleotide: ldbn ldpn, ...). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0.

# Rows db.ldo.

.e2hold.5 (line DBID loadord, review 6 H2, 2026-11-17; the fixtures of the e2* rows): as .e2skip. with multidb/lda (ldan) in place of ldb (ldbn): q1's report, whose Iteration NCBI's XML stream cuts, would read gi|9000|ref|NP_000002.1| of ldd (lddn), but it makes none of its loads, so NCBI looks q2's ref|NP_000002.1| up and stops there; lda's gnl|BL_ORD_ID|0 loads after the stop, so the texts that q1's report left are not written (NCBI's error alone). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0.
